paper_reference.title: An Evidence-First Reproducibility Capsule for NISQ Benchmarking
paper_reference.note: The current paper-facing evidence packet is mirrored under `capsule/`, while `source/` separately anchors the last published Zenodo tarball checksum; chronology commentary and receipt material stay outside the mirror.

paper_reference_capsule.note: This is the primary paper-referenceable sidecar capsule for the current NISQ benchmarking evidence companion, built from the published 82-file allowlist and validated locally via `capsule/checksums.sha256`.

aiir.note: Exact receipt ids, filenames, per-artifact hashes, and Rekor entry details are recorded in aiir/BUNDLESET.json. This packet-bound manifest intentionally avoids duplicating receipt-specific coordinates so the AIIR lane stays authoritative without forcing the packet receipt to chase its own hash.
